full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D06F.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
DETAILED CHARACTER READING AND COUNT:
1. All FOUR witnesses available. Two separate left/right components. LEFT is a SMALL three-horizontal/one-center-stem motif, near-even bar gaps, outer bars longer than middle. Its height only35–45% of tall right component; it sits upper-middle, its bottom near right oval middle, NOT down at lower feet.
2. RIGHT TOP: open U-shaped cup with two free upward side tips, plus a central vertical rising higher than both tips and continuing down through cup floor. THREE upper tips total. Below cup central stem forks into TWO attached outward-sloping chevron shoulders.
3. Upper pair of SHORT DETACHED diagonal strokes flank that central stem BETWEEN cup and large chevron shoulders: one short rising stroke on LEFT, one short falling stroke on RIGHT. Both remain detached from cup/stem/large shoulders. Do NOT omit either short slash.
4. RIGHT MIDDLE: ONE rounded upright oval/rectangle with ONE horizontal divider, exactly TWO white counters. It is ENTIRELY SEPARATE from upper chevron, with clear horizontal air gap. No triangle counter above oval and no roof-to-oval connection in this coherent THX whole form.
5. RIGHT BOTTOM: oval floor joins center descending stem, which forks into TWO long outward-curving legs. Another pair of SHORT DETACHED slant marks flank stem above/outside this lower fork, one left and one right, each free at both ends.
6. Total FOUR SHORT DETACHED diagonal side marks: TWO above oval and TWO below oval. Preserve them in addition to large upper chevron shoulders and large lower forked legs. Only TWO closed counters overall, within oval. U-cup stays open; left compact motif remains separate.
7. Parallel-sided monoline tubes with equal thickness and rounded caps/joins, around3%canvas; no brush wedges or merged ink masses. Give all four short marks clear gaps.
Critical: FOUR separate short diagonal marks, three upper cup tips, two oval counters, two long lower legs. Compact LEFT motif stops around the middle oval's height; never make it full height. Choose the fully detached upper-roof/oval construction attested in THX after comparing CCZ/QJZ/DYC variants, without blending in QJZ roof-to-oval triangular closure. Output one complete balanced original glyph, not modern Chinese.
